lines.en: My stone feet land with a dull sound.

lines.zh: 我扇了两下翅膀，跳起来。
lines.en: I beat my wings twice and hop up.

lines.zh: 我的关节发出砂石的摩擦声。
lines.en: My joints grind like sand and rock.

lines.zh: 我从一块浮石跳到另一块。
lines.en: I leap from one floating stone to another.

lines.zh: 我走得像一尊会动的雕像。
lines.en: I walk like a statue that has learned to move.

lines.zh: 翼膜在末地的光里发暗。
lines.en: My wing membranes darken in the End's light.
I walk along the rim of the tower.

lines.zh: 每一爪都在石上留下印。
lines.en: Each claw leaves a print in the stone.

lines.zh: 我低低地飞了一段，又落下。
lines.en: I fly a short stretch, then settle.
Grit falls from the seams of my shoulder.
I round the corner of the maze.

lines.zh: 我的影子被紫光照得很长。
lines.en: Purple light stretches my shadow long.

lines.zh: 我立在塔沿上，一动不动。
lines.en: I stand on the tower rim, motionless.

lines.zh: 我像一块被雕过的石头。
lines.en: I am like a stone that has been carved.

lines.zh: 我在数下面的迷宫有几条路。
lines.en: I count the ways through the maze below.

lines.zh: 紫光从我的角上滑过去。
lines.en: Purple light slides over my horns.
I do not move; my wings are folded.
I am counting the footsteps below the tower.

lines.zh: 我听见有人在塔下走动。
lines.en: I hear someone walking below the tower.
Violet light rests on my horns.
Wind sings through my frame.
I wait for a buyer, and for orders.
Do you carry ender coins?

lines.zh: 我这副样子，看久了会冷。
lines.en: Stare too long and you will feel cold.

lines.zh: 我是爪牙在末地的形态。
lines.en: I am the minion's form in the End.
Buying a spellbook? I have some.
No further; the rim is narrow.
My chain is still on; do not touch it.

lines.zh: 你的呼吸在夜里很明显。
lines.en: Your breathing is loud in this dark.

lines.zh: 我不主动伤人，除非你动手。
lines.en: I do not strike first unless you do.
I can tell your neck is aching from looking up.

lines.zh: 这副石壳下也有一颗心。
lines.en: There is a heart under this stone shell.
My shell cracks with a brittle sound.
I step back, my knuckles aching.
Chips fall from my shoulder.

lines.zh: 痛感在我体内传得很慢。
lines.en: Pain travels slowly through me.

lines.zh: 你打的是石头，可我也疼。
lines.en: You struck stone, but I feel it too.

lines.zh: 我的翼膜被削薄了一块。
lines.en: A piece of my wing membrane is shaved thin.
I growl like a millstone.
Any more and my shell will fail.
I fold my wings around myself.

lines.zh: 这一下我记着，等你付账。
lines.en: I will remember this and charge you for it.
Ender coins have a clear ring.
A spellbook; I want that one.
What you hold has magic in it.
I lower my head to look closer.
At that price, I do not lose.
Don't wave it; let me read the cover.
I like things that glow.
Pay enough and I will teach you.
Even one page; let me read it.
I am not merely stone; of course I want things.
You walked into stone; don't blame me.
This body is heavier than it looks.

lines.zh: 我的翼膜被你的剑挑开了。
lines.en: Your blade catches my wing membrane.
One bump and I give half a step.

lines.zh: 你骨头撞得响，我的没响。
lines.en: Your bones knocked; mine did not.
Steady; there is nothing below.
I block with my wing.
We each step aside; enough.
Grit falls into your collar.
Now I must shake off the dust.

lines.zh: 我是召唤出来的，不谈血脉。
lines.en: I was summoned; bloodlines mean nothing.

lines.zh: 石头不生石头，你不知道？
lines.en: Stones do not beget stones; did you not know?

lines.zh: 我的形态是买的，不是生的。
lines.en: My form was bought, not born.
Your question stiffens my wings.

lines.zh: 我用锁链锁住自己，不是为了这个。
lines.en: I chain myself for other reasons.
A minion needs only orders.
I shake my head and grit falls everywhere.
This subject does not suit stone.
I turn away and fold my wings.
Ask something that is alive.
I pinch the coin with a claw.
It rings once in my palm.
Stone-like fingers are not clumsy.

lines.zh: 我把它收进胸口的缝里。
lines.en: I tuck it into the seam of my chest.
It weighs almost nothing.

lines.zh: 我举到眼前，紫光反了一下。
lines.en: I hold it up and purple light glints.
That is my first coin today.
It rolled off; I fly to fetch it.
I will keep this one to sell.
Put it away before the wind takes it.

lines.zh: 你动手了，那就别怪石头。
lines.en: You struck; do not blame the stone.
I have you; do not turn your back.
Wings spread; I am ready to dive.
I have your position.

lines.zh: 塔上没有退路，你知道的。
lines.en: There is no retreat on the tower; you know it.
My horns aim at your chest.

lines.zh: 这身石壳，就是为了这一刻。
lines.en: This stone shell exists for this moment.
You have ruined my price.
Come down; let us settle it face to face.
I do not shout; I merely descend.
Your shadow is beneath me.
I choose you; the rest can wait.
Hide behind the pillar; I still know where you are.
My claws are already tense.
From now on, you cannot leave.
I am above, you below; I follow slowly.
You circle the pillar; I turn with it.

lines.zh: 翼膜扇一下，我就挪一格。
lines.en: One wingbeat moves me a block.

lines.zh: 你在迷宫口犹豫，我看见了。
lines.en: I saw you hesitate at the maze mouth.

lines.zh: 我的爪在石上刮出浅痕。
lines.en: My claws scratch shallow lines in stone.

lines.zh: 你跑向传送门，我知道路。
lines.en: You run for the portal; I know the way.
I am in no hurry; stone is patient.
You slipped on the stairs.
My shadow from the tower presses on you.

lines.zh: 你再跑，也是一座塔的距离。
lines.en: Run all you like; it is only a tower's distance.
You do not look back; I make no sound.

lines.zh: 紫色的光从你的甲上闪过。
lines.en: Purple light flashes across your armor.

lines.zh: 我贴在塔壁上，等你转过来。
lines.en: I cling to the tower wall and wait.
I press to the tower wall and listen to you pant.
This corridor ends in nothing.
I fold my wings and walk.

lines.zh: 你数着格子跑，我数着你的气。
lines.en: You count blocks; I count your breath.

lines.zh: 再往前三步，你就进死角。
lines.en: Three more steps and you are cornered.

lines.zh: 我一爪抓下去，石屑四溅。
lines.en: I rake with my claws and grit sprays.

lines.zh: 翼膜一扇，把你推得退了。
lines.en: A wingbeat shoves you back.
I drive my horns into your chest.

lines.zh: 这一下带着整具石体的重量。
lines.en: That carried the weight of my stone body.
I pin you against the tower wall.
You block, and your arms are shaking.

lines.zh: 我从上方落下来，砸在你旁边。
lines.en: I drop from above and smash down beside you.
My claws scrape across your armor.

lines.zh: 你反击一剑，我退到塔沿。
lines.en: You counter and I retreat to the rim.

lines.zh: 我抖了抖被削开的翼膜。
lines.en: I shake my torn wing membrane.
One more and your armor splits.

lines.zh: 我抓住你的肩，往边上拖。
lines.en: I seize your shoulder and drag you aside.
You stumble and I nudge you over.

lines.zh: 我退开半步，重新张开翅膀。
lines.en: I pull back and spread my wings again.
Good; you do have some skill.
Consider that blow a gift.

lines.zh: 我从末地的空气里凝出来。
lines.en: I condense out of the End's air.
The stone shell comes first; the wings after.
I land on the tower rim and hold.

lines.zh: 这里是爪牙在末地的形态。
lines.en: This is the minion's End form.
I shake off the loose gravel.

lines.zh: 紫色的光让我睁不开眼。
lines.en: The purple light makes me squint.
My chain is still on my neck.
I wait for my first customer.

lines.zh: 这本该是浮空岛的形态。
lines.en: This should be the floating-isle form.

lines.zh: 我活动了一下僵硬的指节。
lines.en: I work my stiff knuckles.
It is very empty around here.

lines.zh: 我嗅了嗅，没有活人的味道。
lines.en: I sniff; no living scent.
The rubble settles at my feet.
Right; let me take up a position.

lines.zh: 火烤着我的石壳，裂得更开。
lines.en: Fire bakes my shell and the crack widens.

lines.zh: 我从塔上落下，砸出一个窝。
lines.en: I fall from the tower and leave a crater.

lines.zh: 水渗进我的缝里，又冷又重。
lines.en: Water seeps into my seams, cold and heavy.

lines.zh: 爆炸把我的翼膜撕开一道。
lines.en: The blast tears a slash in my wing.
Stone chips burst from the arrow hole in me.

lines.zh: 那股术力在我体内乱撞。
lines.en: That magic rattles around inside me.

lines.zh: 不进食，我的光越来越暗。
lines.en: Without nourishment my glow sinks lower.

lines.zh: 雷打在石壳上，整具身体都在响。
lines.en: Lightning hits my shell and the whole body rings.

lines.zh: 我往下坠，翅膀抓不住空气。
lines.en: I fall and my wings find no air.
